title: TMI Flagship Commercial Operating System, UX Performance Baseline, and Proof-Readiness Architecture
scope: documentation-only, internal decision architecture, no offer activated
boundaryRule: Current industry guidance can inform TMI's private operating baseline. It does not establish that TMI is certified, compliant, secure, safe, effective, qualified, operational, ready for public use, or authorized to make public claims.
strategicFraming: Platform advantage (integrated infrastructure + cultural intelligence), not a proven claim of leadership, superiority, compliance, safety, qualification, performance, financial success, results, or operational maturity. Immediate objective: define one narrow flagship consulting engagement, not vertical expansion.

whether this is ever offered independently

whether to ever pursue this at all, held until flagship proof exists

deliveryPhasesSummary.audit: property inventory, current-state map, risk/opportunity register - no guaranteed finding

deliveryPhasesSummary.compound: documentation, governance review, measurement plan - no recurring support/SLA unless separately defined

inScopeResponsibilities: controlled future build support (separately approved only)

app/agent/custom-software delivery without separate approved scope
